## Grid of Predicted Baryons Beyond the Doubly-Charmed Family

The diagrams supply the vector sets {U, D, S, C, B, T}.  
Interactions (phase-capture cascades / wavy-line binding of Mirron cores) among these sets generate the higher multiplets.  

Only states with **three or more heavy quarks** (or two heavy + one light that extend beyond pure double-charm) are listed. Ground-state spin-½ and spin-3½ possibilities are noted where relevant; masses are representative lattice or quark-model estimates.

- Exact numbers for mixed states remain model-dependent; the hierarchical stretch \(n_{\rm hier}\approx45.8\) in TSB places them at successively higher binding levels.

## How the Diagram Interactions Produce the Grid

- Upper pink oval (multiple C + S) × itself → triply-charmed (ccc).  
- Upper pink oval (C) × lower pink oval (B or T) → doubly-charmed + beauty/top.  
- Lower pink oval (B, T) × itself → fully beauty, beauty-top, and top-dominated states.  
- Any of the above × light vector sets (yellow U/D ovals) or S → the charge and strangeness variants (Ξ vs Ω).  

All such combinations are realized in TSB as multi-Mirron bound states whose total phase occupation remains compatible with TEP cycle closure at the appropriate hierarchical level.
